title: Is it Too Late to Buy Shopify Stock Right Now? | SHOP Stock Analysis
creator: Parkevtate Vosianc CFA
summary: Parkevtate asks whether Shopify's agentic-AI-driven run has made it too late to buy and answers yes for now: the forward P/E has nearly doubled in 2026 to 72 and his DCF fair value is $66 vs the $177 market price, near the 52-week high. He praises the asset-light model and improving margins/ROIC after the reversed logistics expansion, but says the valuation is rich and he would wait for a better opportunity. Call: AVOID.

calls.video_title: Is it Too Late to Buy Shopify Stock Right Now? | SHOP Stock Analysis
calls.price_at_call: $177 (stated current, near 52-week high); fair value $66 (stated DCF)
calls.thesis: AVOID / not a buying opportunity — asked if it is too late to buy, he answers no to buying now: 'the valuation looks rich, I would wait for a better opportunity.' Forward P/E has nearly doubled in 2026 from ~36 to 72 and his DCF fair value is $66 vs $177 market. He likes the asset-light business (a former shareholder who sold when it expanded into logistics) but not at this price. First tracked Parkevtate SHOP call in calls.json — no flip.
calls.base_case: Revenue $13.3B TTM, up nearly 13x from ~$1B in 2017; operating margin improving to 17.82% and ROIC back to 14.6% (slightly above WACC) after reversing the failed delivery/logistics expansion; agentic AI is directing consumers to merchant sites, lifting traffic and transaction volume.
calls.bull_case: E-commerce is still a relatively small share of US transactions with a multi-trillion-dollar, decades-long runway, so a premium valuation is deserved — he puts a reasonable forward P/E at 40-55, not 72.
calls.bear_case: At 72x forward earnings the market is far more optimistic than his DCF ($66); agentic-AI optimism is already priced in near the 52-week high.
